hooks.command: file_path=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; raw=sys.stdin.read().strip() or '{}'; d=json.loads(raw) if raw[:1]=='{' else {}; print((d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path',''))"); case "$file_path" in *.py) uv run ruff check --fix "$file_path"; uv run ruff format "$file_path" 2>/dev/null; exit 0;; *) exit 0;; esac

file_path=$(python3 -c "import json,sys; raw=sys.stdin.read().strip() or '{}'; d=json.loads(raw) if raw[:1]=='{' else {}; print((d.get('tool_input') or {}).get('file_path',''))"); case "$file_path" in *.py) uv run ty check "$file_path"; exit 0;; *) exit 0;; esac
